en: The image is a vintage postcard depicting a marketplace (piața) in front of a classic European building, with several people gathered and horse-drawn carriages parked in the square. The architecture is central-European, and the scene has a painted or hand-colored look. There is a mountain visible in the background. The postcard includes the text 'Piatra-Neamț, Piata' at the top.
